scope: paired synthetic-only event-only SingleShotPose seed-0 candidate with confidence phase and synthetic-train BN calibration
purpose: replay the repaired per-interval event windows and reach the pinned SingleShotPose confidence-loss phase after its 15-epoch coordinate pretrain

upstream_model.initialization: random paired initialization; LINEMOD weights are not used

input.source: raw events from the paired EventGenesis or V2E stream
input.window: (t_i,t_i+1], with the right endpoint exactly equal to the shared pose-label time

labels.source: shared Genesis target pose, camera pose, actual camera K, and configured box dimensions
labels.time_reference: right endpoint of event window; persisted for every sample
labels.single_shot_pose_format: class, projected centroid, eight projected 3D cuboid corners, normalized x/y extent

training.loss: pinned SingleShotPose RegionLoss coordinate warmup for epochs 1-15 followed by confidence-supervised coordinate loss for epochs 16-31
training.budget_note: Preserves the pinned 15-epoch coordinate warmup, then supplies at least 128 confidence-supervised optimizer updates when 8 train windows are available; script refuses to train if the actual paired train split yields fewer.
training.batchnorm_calibration: After optimizer updates, reset and cumulatively estimate all BN running stats using each event-only synthetic train input once; no labels, validation, or real data; model returned to eval before validation/inference.

diagnostics.primary_validation: ordinary model.eval() confidence-argmax inference after train-only BN calibration
additional_synthetic_only_checks: record BN calibration sample IDs/hash and per-layer num_batches_tracked
normal eval mode confidence argmax on held-out physical rollouts
checkpoint restore followed by same normal eval inference
